The '''High Priestess''' was the head of the [[Order of the Sacred Circle]] religion. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] held the position.

It was also the [[Gender/Legends|female]] name for the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] rank of [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]].

[[Komari Vosa]] held this title while ruling the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] death cult.
